title: OpenMedSettings
description: Declared OpenMed environment settings, grouped into named sections. Each property is one environment variable; its JSON type describes the parsed value. The schema declares settings only and never carries deployment values.

core.title: Core
core.description: Library settings that map onto OpenMedConfig fields declared in config.schema.json.

HF_TOKEN.description: Hugging Face token for private models; kept in memory only.

OPENMED_CONFIG.description: OpenMedConfig TOML file loaded when no path is passed.
OPENMED_CONFIG.x-default-note: the directory follows XDG_CONFIG_HOME when it is set.

OPENMED_DEVICE.description: Legacy torch device override, checked after OPENMED_TORCH_DEVICE.

OPENMED_OFFLINE.description: Keep inference and de-identification cache-only; any value other than 0, false, no, off or empty enables it.

OPENMED_PROFILE.x-default-note: the REST service treats an unset profile as prod.

OPENMED_TORCH_DEVICE.description: Torch device override checked when the configured device is unset or auto.
OPENMED_TORCH_DEVICE.x-default-note: unset selects MPS, then CUDA, then CPU.

service.title: Service
service.description: REST, gRPC and GraphQL service settings read under openmed/service/.

OPENMED_SERVICE_ADMISSION_MAX_CONCURRENC.description: Fair-admission global in-flight request ceiling; 0 leaves that level unlimited.

OPENMED_SERVICE_ADMISSION_MAX_QUEUE.description: Requests that may wait at the global admission level; 0 rejects a request that cannot start at once.

OPENMED_SERVICE_ADMISSION_NAMESPACE_CLAI.description: JWT claim whose value names the admission namespace; unset disables namespace accounting.

OPENMED_SERVICE_ADMISSION_NAMESPACE_MAX_.description: Fair-admission per-namespace in-flight request ceiling; 0 leaves that level unlimited.
Requests that may wait at the per-namespace admission level; 0 rejects a request that cannot start at once.

OPENMED_SERVICE_ADMISSION_PRINCIPAL_MAX_.description: Fair-admission per-principal in-flight request ceiling; 0 leaves that level unlimited.
Requests that may wait at the per-principal admission level; 0 rejects a request that cannot start at once.

OPENMED_SERVICE_ADMISSION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_.description: Seconds a queued request waits for admission before it is rejected.

OPENMED_SERVICE_ADMISSION_RETRY_AFTER_SE.description: Retry-After seconds returned with an admission rejection.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_API_KEYS.description: Hashed static API-key credentials as a JSON list (or an object with a keys list).

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_API_KEYS_FILE.description: File holding OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_API_KEYS, such as a mounted secret.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_DENY_BY_DEFAULT.description: Require authentication on routes that have no explicit scope policy.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_ENABLED.description: Enable API-key and JWT authentication for the REST and gRPC service.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_FAILURE_RATE_LIMIT_.description: Burst capacity of the failed-authentication rate limiter.
Client identity that keys failed-authentication buckets (aliases process, xff, client and remote are accepted).
Refill rate of the failed-authentication rate limiter, per second.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_JWKS.description: Inline JSON Web Key Set used to verify bearer JWTs.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_JWKS_FILE.description: File holding the JSON Web Key Set used to verify bearer JWTs.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE.description: Comma- or space-separated accepted JWT audiences (aud); empty accepts any.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_JWT_ISSUER.description: Required JWT issuer (iss); unset accepts any issuer.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_JWT_LEEWAY_SECONDS.description: Clock-skew leeway in seconds for JWT time claims.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_JWT_MAX_LIFETIME_SE.description: Longest accepted JWT lifetime in seconds.
OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_JWT_MAX_LIFETIME_SE.x-default-note: 3600 under the prod security profile; unset under dev applies no lifetime cap.

OPENMED_SERVICE_AUTH_ROUTE_SCOPES.description: JSON object of per-route scope overrides keyed by 'METHOD /path'.

OPENMED_SERVICE_BATCHING_ENABLED.description: Enable dynamic batching for model-backed REST endpoints.

OPENMED_SERVICE_BATCH_HIGH_WATERMARK.description: Outstanding-request depth at which load shedding starts.

OPENMED_SERVICE_BATCH_LOW_WATERMARK.description: Depth below which load shedding stops; must be below the high watermark.

OPENMED_SERVICE_BATCH_MAX_QUEUE_WAIT_MS.description: Longest time in milliseconds a request may wait before batch dispatch.

OPENMED_SERVICE_BATCH_MAX_WAIT_MS.description: Milliseconds a batch waits to fill before dispatch.

OPENMED_SERVICE_BULK_INPUT_ROOTS.description: Comma-separated local directories FHIR bulk jobs may read from.

OPENMED_SERVICE_BULK_JOB_TTL_SECONDS.description: Seconds a terminal FHIR bulk job record is retained.

OPENMED_SERVICE_BULK_MAX_RETAINED_JOBS.description: Largest number of retained FHIR bulk job records.

OPENMED_SERVICE_BULK_MAX_RUNNING_JOBS.description: Largest number of concurrently running FHIR bulk jobs.

OPENMED_SERVICE_BULK_OUTPUT_ROOT.description: Local directory under which FHIR bulk jobs write their output.

OPENMED_SERVICE_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_FAILURE_.description: Consecutive failures that open the circuit breaker.

OPENMED_SERVICE_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RECOVERY.description: Seconds an open circuit breaker waits before a trial call.

OPENMED_SERVICE_CONCURRENCY_WAIT_SECONDS.description: Seconds a request waits for a concurrency slot before rejection.

OPENMED_SERVICE_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated exact CORS origins; wildcards are rejected.

OPENMED_SERVICE_DEFAULT_MODEL_FOOTPRINT_.description: Assumed per-model memory footprint for admission when a model reports none.

OPENMED_SERVICE_DIGEST_KEY.description: Deployment secret, at least 32 bytes, for keyed digests of identifiers in job records and audits.

OPENMED_SERVICE_DIGEST_KEY_FILE.description: File holding OPENMED_SERVICE_DIGEST_KEY, such as a mounted secret.

OPENMED_SERVICE_DIGEST_KEY_ID.description: Public identifier recorded with keyed digests.

OPENMED_SERVICE_EXPERIMENTAL_MULTIMODAL_.description: Enable the experimental multimodal preflight route.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_DEADLINE_SECONDS.description: Seconds one GraphQL request may run, from body parsing to cleanup.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_ALIASES.description: Aliased fields after GraphQL fragment expansion.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_DEPTH.description: Field nesting after GraphQL fragment expansion.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_DOCUMENT_BYT.description: UTF-8 bytes allowed in a GraphQL query document.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_FRAGMENTS.description: Fragment definitions allowed in one GraphQL document.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_NESTING.description: Deepest bracket nesting in a GraphQL document.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_NODES.description: Syntax-tree nodes allowed in a parsed GraphQL document.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_OPERATIONS.description: Operation definitions allowed in one GraphQL document.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_SELECTED_FIE.description: Field selections after GraphQL fragment expansion.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_TOKENS.description: Lexical tokens allowed in a GraphQL document.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_VARIABLES.description: Variables supplied with, or declared by, a GraphQL request.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_VARIABLE_BYT.description: Compact UTF-8 JSON size of GraphQL variables.

OPENMED_SERVICE_GRAPHQL_MAX_VARIABLE_DEP.description: Container nesting allowed in GraphQL variables.

OPENMED_SERVICE_IDEMPOTENCY_MAX_KEYS.description: Largest number of remembered idempotency keys.

OPENMED_SERVICE_IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_SECONDS.description: Seconds an idempotency key is remembered.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_LEASE_SECONDS.description: Seconds a worker's async job lease lasts before recovery may reclaim it.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: Attempts per async job, including the first.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_MAX_DOCUMENTS.description: Largest number of documents in one async job.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_MAX_PENDING.description: Largest number of pending async jobs.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_MAX_QUEUED_BYTES.description: Largest total queued async job text, in bytes.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_PAYLOAD_DIR.description: Directory for encrypted async job payloads.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_PAYLOAD_MODE.description: Async job payload retention: memory only, or encrypted on disk with a caller-supplied key provider.
OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_PAYLOAD_MODE.x-default-note: unset keeps payloads in memory unless a key provider is supplied.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_PAYLOAD_RETENTION_S.description: Longest async job payload retention in seconds.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_RECONCILE_SECONDS.description: Interval of the background async job reconcile pass; 0 disables it.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS.description: Base retry delay for async jobs, in seconds.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS.description: Largest retry delay for async jobs, in seconds.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOBS_TTL_SECONDS.description: Seconds terminal async job metadata is retained.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOURNEY_GRANTS.description: Inline Journey grant document as JSON; set this or the file form, not both.

OPENMED_SERVICE_JOURNEY_GRANTS_FILE.description: File holding the Journey grant document.

OPENMED_SERVICE_KEEP_ALIVE.description: Default model keep-alive as seconds or a duration such as 5m; unset or off keeps models resident.

OPENMED_SERVICE_LISTEN_HOST.description: Bind host recorded by the reference launcher for the security-profile self-check.

OPENMED_SERVICE_LISTEN_TLS.description: Whether the listener terminates TLS, recorded by the reference launcher.

OPENMED_SERVICE_LOG_FORMAT.description: Access-log format: plain or text selects plain lines, anything else JSON.

OPENMED_SERVICE_LOG_LEVEL.description: Access-log level name or number; off disables the access log.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES.description: Largest accepted request body in bytes.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MAX_RESIDENT_MODELS.description: Largest number of models kept resident in the warm pool; unset is unbounded.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MAX_TEXT_LENGTH.description: Largest request text in characters; invalid values fall back to the default.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MLX_PAGED_KV_CACHE_BUDGE.description: MLX-LM paged KV-cache memory budget in bytes or a size such as 2GiB; 0 disables the paged cache.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MLX_PAGED_KV_CACHE_BYTES.description: Estimated KV-cache bytes per token used for MLX budget accounting.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MLX_PAGED_KV_CACHE_CHUNK.description: Prefill chunk size in tokens for the MLX paged KV cache.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MLX_PAGED_KV_CACHE_PAGE_.description: Tokens per MLX paged KV-cache page.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MLX_PAGED_KV_CACHE_WINDO.description: Sliding attention window in tokens for the MLX paged KV cache; unset keeps the full context.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MODEL_ADMISSION_WAIT_SEC.description: Seconds a model load waits for memory budget before rejection.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MODEL_MEMORY_BUDGET_BYTE.description: Warm-pool memory budget in bytes or a size such as 4GiB; unset is unbounded.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_CA_BUNDLE.description: CA bundle that verifies client certificates; required with mTLS.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_CLIENT_CERT_HEADER.description: Header a trusted proxy uses to forward the client certificate.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_CRL_FAIL_CLOSED.description: Reject requests when a CRL is invalid or stale; only dev and test profiles may disable it.
OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_CRL_FAIL_CLOSED.x-default-note: false under the dev and test profiles.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_CRL_FILES.description: Comma-separated local PEM or DER certificate revocation list files.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_CRL_GRACE_SECONDS.description: Seconds a CRL stays usable past its next-update time.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_ENABLED.description: Require client certificates (mTLS) for the service.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_PRINCIPALS.description: JSON list mapping certificate subjects or SANs to principals.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_RELOAD_INTERVAL_SEC.description: Poll interval for reloading the CA bundle and CRLs; unset disables reloading.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated proxy addresses or CIDR networks allowed to forward client certificates.

OPENMED_SERVICE_MTLS_TRUST_OVERLAP_SECON.description: Seconds a replaced CA bundle stays trusted after a reload.

OPENMED_SERVICE_OPENAPI_ENABLED.description: Serve /openapi.json; outside the dev profile it stays behind authentication and the HTML docs stay disabled.

OPENMED_SERVICE_OTLP_ENDPOINT.description: OTLP exporter endpoint for traces; setting it opts in to tracing.

OPENMED_SERVICE_OTLP_HEADERS.description: Comma-separated key=value headers sent to the OTLP exporter, such as credentials.

OPENMED_SERVICE_OTLP_HEADERS_FILE.description: File holding OPENMED_SERVICE_OTLP_HEADERS, such as a mounted secret.

OPENMED_SERVICE_PRELOAD_MODELS.description: Comma-separated model identifiers loaded at startup.

OPENMED_SERVICE_PRIVACY_GATEWAY_ENDPOINT.description: External LLM endpoint that receives only redacted content through the privacy gateway; unset disables the gateway transport.

OPENMED_SERVICE_RATE_LIMIT_BURST.description: Token-bucket burst capacity; 0 disables rate limiting.

OPENMED_SERVICE_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_CONCURREN.description: Largest number of in-flight model requests; 0 leaves it unlimited.

OPENMED_SERVICE_RATE_LIMIT_RPS.description: Token-bucket refill rate in requests per second; 0 disables rate limiting.

OPENMED_SERVICE_REPLICA_ACCEPT_LOCAL_STA.description: Comma-separated replica-local components accepted in multi-replica mode.

OPENMED_SERVICE_REPLICA_MODE.description: Replica topology the service is deployed in.

OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_BODY_GRACE_SECON.description: Seconds before the minimum body transfer rate applies.

OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_BODY_MIN_BYTES_P.description: Minimum request body transfer rate once the grace period is spent.

OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_BODY_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: Seconds allowed to receive a whole request body.

OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_SIGNING_MAX_SKEW.description: Largest accepted request-signature clock skew in seconds.

OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_SIGNING_NONCE_CA.description: Nonces remembered for request-signature replay protection.

OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_SIGNING_ROUTES.description: Comma-separated 'METHOD /template' routes that require an HMAC request signature.

OPENMED_SERVICE_REQUEST_SIGNING_SECRET_F.description: File holding the request-signing HMAC secret; required with signed routes.

OPENMED_SERVICE_RESILIENCE_ENABLED.description: Enable retries and circuit breaking around model calls.

OPENMED_SERVICE_RETRY_BACKOFF_JITTER_SEC.description: Random jitter added to each retry backoff, in seconds.

OPENMED_SERVICE_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: Attempts per model call, including the first.

OPENMED_SERVICE_SECURITY_PROFILE.x-default-note: unset follows OPENMED_PROFILE: dev, test and fast select dev; anything else selects prod.

OPENMED_SERVICE_SERVED_MODELS.description: Comma-separated model identifiers network requests may select.
OPENMED_SERVICE_SERVED_MODELS.x-default-note: unset serves the built-in default models plus the preloaded ones.

OPENMED_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS.description: Seconds accepted work may finish during graceful shutdown.

OPENMED_SERVICE_SHUTDOWN_RELEASE_SECONDS.description: Seconds for the flush-and-release window after the shutdown drain.

OPENMED_SERVICE_STREAM_MAX_EVENTS.description: Largest number of NDJSON events one stream may emit.

OPENMED_SERVICE_STREAM_WRITE_IDLE_SECOND.description: Seconds one NDJSON stream write may stay blocked on the client.

OPENMED_SERVICE_SYSTEM_ONE.description: Enable the opt-in POST /v1/systemone privacy route.

OPENMED_SERVICE_THROTTLE_KEY.description: Client identity that keys throttle buckets (aliases process, xff, client and remote are accepted).

OPENMED_SERVICE_THROTTLE_MAX_TRACKED_KEY.description: Per-limiter bound on tracked client identities.

OPENMED_SERVICE_TIMEOUT_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOW.description: Seconds shutdown waits for open connections before cancelling.

OPENMED_SERVICE_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE.description: Seconds an idle HTTP keep-alive connection stays open.

OPENMED_SERVICE_TRUSTED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated allowed Host header values; the global '*' is rejected.

OPENMED_SERVICE_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated reverse-proxy addresses or CIDR networks whose X-Forwarded-For entries may identify clients.

OPENMED_SERVICE_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS.description: Trusted proxy hops skipped when reading X-Forwarded-For.
